title: Coefficient coordinates for raw homogeneous ideal multiplication
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion, L an invertible module, J=ker j with J²=0, n,e≥0, D=canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons(j,L,J²=0,n), and f:O_Z→(j*L)^n [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Put F=j*(J tensor L^n), N=(j*L)^n, d=n(e+1), a=n(0+1), t=n((e+1)+1), and h:d+a=t. For s=tensorPowSection(f,1) ≫ (D.a 0).inv, the explicit raw multiplication m=tensorIdealSectionMultiply(j,L,a,d,t,h,s) [lem-sc-tensor-homogeneous-kernel-action] equals boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso_e.hom ≫ mulTensorPowSection(f,F,e,1) ≫ boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso_(e+1).inv as maps j*(J tensor L^d)→j*(J tensor L^t). This is an equality on Z before pushforward or passage to kernels, independent of any graded presentation or action.

proof.text: Replace D by the canonical package using hD. section_degree_zero proves that tensorPowSection f 1 followed by the inverse section-degree comparison is f followed by boundaryPullbackPowIso in degree n inverted, then the pullback of the exponent cast n=n(0+1). The proof uses the existing private tensorPowMulIso_one_inv in BoundaryCoefficientDegreeSplit, cancels the right unitors, and uses exponent naturality of boundaryPullbackPowIso. raw_cast removes this section cast by equality elimination and proof irrelevance.

Factor each coefficient comparison into the pullback of blockIso and coeffIso. The proved private tensorPowMulIso_add_inv in SectionRingVeroneseNumeratorTransition gives block_concat_inv by tensoring with the unchanged ideal factor and applying the associator pentagon. tensorPowMulIso_one_inv, the proved private identity in BoundaryCoefficientDegreeSplit, cancels the degree-one unit factor; exponent naturality gives block_append. These are actual closed library tensor identities, not assumptions about section-ring numerators.

Tensor powers of an isomorphism preserve concatenation, by the proved private powIso_add induction. Combine this with boundaryPullbackPowIso_append to obtain pullback_pow_append_iso. The private coefficient_append calculation uses the transported monoidal tensorator, its naturality, associativity and unitors to conjugate pullback multiplication to mulTensorPowSection. Precompose the desired identity by the inverse degree-e coefficient comparison and postcompose by the degree-(e+1) comparison. Naturality moves the pulled-back blockIso through the right unitor, the section, and the tensorator; combine the functor maps and apply block_append. The remaining composite is precisely coefficient_append. Cancel the two isomorphisms. Every argument includes n=0 and e=0.

theorem tensorIdealSectionMultiply_coefficient_comparison {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (n : ℕ) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D) (e : ℕ)
    (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (h : n * (e + 1) + n * (0 + 1) = n * ((e + 1) + 1)) :
    tensorIdealSectionMultiply j L (n * (0 + 1)) (n * (e + 1))
        (n * ((e + 1) + 1)) h (tensorPowSection f 1 ≫ (D.a 0).inv) =
      (boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso j L n e).hom ≫
        mulTensorPowSection f ((tensorPullback j).obj
          (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n)) e 1 ≫
        (boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso j L n (e + 1)).inv
